svg.title: Stage 3 use case: a VIP orders a combo during Happy Hour and is served, eats and pays

g.text: Stage 3 use case: a VIP orders a combo during Happy Hour and is served, eats and pays
(replay: runs/stage3-victory.txt, turns 7-12 and the result check after turn 18)
(start of turn 7): C1 has paid, C2 (Critic) is eating at Table 2,
Table 1 is free, Happy Hour is still available, the queue is empty.
: C3 (VIP) pays $17.50 (instead of $24.30) with satisfaction 90 on turn 12; game ends in VICTORY.
Turn 7: arrival, Happy Hour, seating, order, first prep unit
task not used up; ask again
VIP discount first, then Happy Hour
price locked when the order is taken
Turns 8-9: kitchen (Happy Hour still active on turn 8: c3 recovers 95 -> 100, then loses 5)
end of turn 9: Happy Hour over; c3 satisfaction 90
Turn 10: staff constraint - the manager's choice changes the outcome
C4 arrives; Host seats C4. The Waiter can do ONE task:
serve C3 (READY) or take C4's order. The manager chooses to serve C3,
so C3 stops losing satisfaction and pays with 90. (Taking C4's order first
would cost C3 another 5 points and delay revenue by a turn.)
Turn 12: payment (Cashier runs before finishEating, so it pays a turn later)
